questions.question_text: Manushya dehe karīne na thāy evu shu chhe? Je nitye ......... rākhīne kare te thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.33, 'Manushya dehe karīne na thāy evu shu chhe? Je nitye abhyās rākhīne kare te thāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: Have āj dinthī āpaṇā satsangmā koī paṇ evī ......... vāt karsho nahī, sadā himmatya sahit ja vāt karjyo.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.17, 'Have āj dinthī āpaṇā satsangmā koī paṇ evī himmatyarahit vāt karsho nahī, sadā himmatya sahit ja vāt karjyo.'

questions.question_text: Ane je evī himmatyarahit vāt kare tene to ......... jāṇvo.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.17, 'Ane je evī himmatyarahit vāt kare tene to napunsak jāṇvo.'

questions.question_text: Jevā ......... sāmbhaḷe tevo jīv thaī jāy chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Swa. Vato: 1/177, 'Jevā shabd sāmbhaḷe tevo jīv thaī jāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: Māṭe baḷiyā Bhagwānnā bhakta hoy tenā ......... sāmbhaḷīe to jīvmā baḷ āve, paṇ napunsakne sange baḷ pamāy nahī.
questions.explanation: According to Swa. Vato: 1/177, 'Māṭe baḷiyā Bhagwānnā bhakta hoy tenā shabd sāmbhaḷīe to jīvmā baḷ āve, paṇ napunsakne sange baḷ pamāy nahī.'

questions.question_text: Bhagwān ne sādhunā ......... vātu nirantar karvī ne sāmbhaḷvī.
questions.explanation: According to Swa. Vato: 1/1, 'Bhagwān ne sādhunā mahimānī vātu nirantar karvī ne sāmbhaḷvī.'

questions.question_text: Mahārāje anant prakārnī vātu jīvnā ......... arthe pravartāvī chhe; paṇ temā chār vātu chhe te to jīvnu jīvan chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Swa. Vato: 3/9, 'Mahārāje anant prakārnī vātu jīvnā mokshane arthe pravartāvī chhe; paṇ temā chār vātu chhe te to jīvnu jīvan chhe.'
According to Haricharitramrutsagar, 'Bhaktoe paraspar suhṛudbhāv rākhvo.'

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnā bhakta chhe te to kevaḷ ......... ja mūrtio chhe, ene viṣhe to manushyabhāv lāvvo ja nahī.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.63, 'Bhagwānnā bhakta chhe te to kevaḷ brahmanī ja mūrtio chhe, ene viṣhe to manushyabhāv lāvvo ja nahī.'

questions.question_text: Sarve haribhaktane atishay ......... yukt dekhu chhu.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.An.2, 'sarve haribhaktane atishay prakāshe yukt dekhu chhu.'
